_comment: Sponsor slots, keyed by the token name the templates use. Nothing read this file before 2026-09-20, so every <!--OPTIONAL:sponsor_*--> block was stripped and no slot had ever rendered. A slot with an empty name is dropped and its block is removed from the page. The 'label' controls the small eyebrow, so an unsold slot can read 'Sponsor slot' while a sold one reads 'Presented by'.
